items.a: The initial visit costs Gs 300,000–450,000 depending on complexity. It includes review, diagnosis, and a clear quote. No surprises.
We operate as a private practice and do not have direct contracts with insurers. We issue legal invoices with RUC so you can claim reimbursement on your own. Most plans allow this.
Yes. I regularly treat international patients and the full visit can be in English if you prefer.
First visit: 45–60 minutes. Checkups: 20–30 minutes. For specific procedures I tell you exactly how long before we start.

items.q: What should I bring to my first appointment?
items.a: Bring previous X-rays or studies if you have them, your insurance or coverage card (for reimbursement even if we’re not direct), a list of current medications, and any questions in writing so you don’t forget.
Yes. Write me on WhatsApp and we’ll coordinate availability.

items.q: What if I don’t need treatment?
items.a: If you don’t need treatment, I’ll tell you. I don’t invent problems just to charge for something unnecessary. My job is honest evaluation.
Parking details are confirmed at booking. I provide practical arrival instructions so you know where to leave the car before the visit.
Yes, I do endodontics. If a case is very complex, I’ll tell you and refer you to a trusted endodontist. I don’t do work beyond what I can do well.
I do simple extractions. For wisdom teeth or surgical cases, I work with trusted maxillofacial surgeons and coordinate the full process.

items.q: Do you do crowns or bridges?
items.a: Yes. I use zirconia for crowns because it’s the most resistant and biocompatible option. I explain the choices and you decide with full information.
From around 10–12 years onward. For younger children or cases requiring specific behavior management, I refer to a trusted pediatric dentist. I won’t start if the child isn’t comfortable.
Yes — direct composite veneers, porcelain veneers, and in-office whitening. My philosophy is to preserve as much natural structure as possible. I don’t repeat work just for appearance.

items.q: What dental emergencies do you handle?
items.a: For strong pain, bleeding, or a broken tooth, WhatsApp me immediately. For severe cases — fever with swelling or trauma — I’ll tell you if the hospital emergency room is safer.
Yes, this is one of my main services. Bring your studies and I’ll give you an honest, written opinion on what you really need before any irreversible step.

items.q: What does a written second opinion include?
items.a: Case review, clinical exam, written report with findings and options. It doesn’t repeat the original treatment automatically — it tells you whether it makes sense.
X-rays, previous estimates, and any existing clinical records. The more information, the more precise the opinion.
Cash, bank transfer, Pagopar, or Bancard POS. For larger treatments, payment plans are available. Every case is documented with a legal invoice.
They’re reference prices. The final cost is confirmed during the visit before any procedure begins.
For cases over Gs 1M, installments are available through Pagopar or Bancard. The patient absorbs the financing fee.

items.q: How do I cancel or reschedule?
items.a: Message me on WhatsApp at least 24 hours in advance. No penalty — just notice so I can offer the slot to someone else.
Not currently. I usually have availability within one to two weeks.
Call or WhatsApp as soon as you can. If I can reschedule within the same day, I will; otherwise we’ll find the next available slot.
